body.name: Minimum-cost simultaneous attainable-rank augmentation
body.construction:
Let \(q_{\max}=\max_{x\in\mathcal X}q_x\), and, when the feasible family is nonempty, define
\[
F_*\in\arg\min_{F\subseteq E^+}
\left\{\sum_{e\in F}c^+(e):
r_{q_{\max}}(E\cup F)=q_{\max}(|V|-1)\right\}.
\]
Compute this optimizer in the union of \(q_{\max}\) copies of the graphic matroid on \(E\cup E^+\) by contracting any basis of the restriction to \(E\), deleting the remaining elements of \(E\), and finding a minimum-weight basis on the candidate edges.
